classifications.B: selected fields or approved value transform

tables.name: Campaign
tables.reason: The historical fields and enum values are current-schema compatible.

tables.name: CampaignAsset
tables.reason: Historical columns are copied; later storage-metadata columns use migration defaults. The verified source has no rows.

tables.name: CampaignRosterEntry
tables.reason: Compatible rows are copied. Every membership for a Character found in multiple Campaigns is retained in the manifest as provenance and omitted from current roster authority.

tables.name: CanonicalContentSnapshot
tables.reason: Historical cached canonical content is not current repository content authority.

tables.name: Character
tables.reason: Base rows, stable IDs, timestamps, and historical build JSON are copied. No retained revisions or ledger events are fabricated.

tables.name: CharacterEquipmentItem
tables.reason: The canonical item authority rows are copied without fabricating acquisition or provenance events. Embedded-versus-canonical conflicts are reported, not resolved.

tables.name: CharacterLoadout
tables.reason: Existing loadout facts and stable IDs are compatible and copied without loadout-event history.

tables.name: CharacterStorageLocation
tables.reason: Existing storage facts are current-schema compatible.

tables.name: Encounter
tables.reason: Rows and combat evidence are copied, but every Encounter status is normalized to archived so historical active/setup/planned rows cannot become current live play. Original status counts remain provenance.

tables.name: EncounterActiveCombatState
tables.reason: Historical combat state is retained as read-only evidence behind an archived Encounter. No progression service runs.

tables.name: EncounterArchivedCombatRound
tables.reason: Historical archived rounds are directly representable.

tables.name: ReusableEntity
tables.reason: Historical reusable entities are current-schema compatible.

tables.name: Role
tables.reason: Role identity is directly compatible.

tables.name: Scenario
tables.reason: Compatible status values are copied and closed maps exactly to completed. Lifecycle revision/cycle values remain manifest provenance because the current schema has no approved field.

tables.name: ScenarioEventLog
tables.reason: Historical event records are directly representable and copied without replay.

tables.name: ScenarioLifecycleTransition
tables.reason: The current schema has no approved lifecycle-transition table. The verified source has no rows.

tables.name: ScenarioParticipant
tables.reason: Participant rows and snapshots are directly representable.

tables.name: ScenarioRelationship
tables.reason: The continues_from relationship is directly compatible.

tables.name: Session
tables.reason: All historical sessions and token hashes are intentionally omitted.

tables.name: User
tables.reason: Stable identity and password hashes are copied only after every hash passes the current scrypt format proof. Hash values never enter manifests or logs.

tables.name: UserRole
tables.reason: Assignments are directly compatible.

tables.name: Weapon
tables.reason: Legacy standalone Weapon rows are directly compatible. The verified source has no rows.

tables.name: _prisma_migrations
tables.reason: Historical migration lineage is verified as source provenance; target migration history comes only from current committed migrations.
